text:
maria: Auditor asked for an evidence package showing RBAC changes + related logs for key service accounts between 2026-01-01 and 2026-02-15. Need mapping to SOC 2 CC6 and ISO A.9 controls.

raj: I can pull. Which resources exactly? k8s rolebindings, S3 buckets, KMS key usage? We should include RBAC diffs, rolebinding YAMLs, and principal mapping.

maria: Primary scope: kubernetes rolebindings (prod-us, prod-eu), KMS key access events (alias=redwood-prod-unseal), and service account token usage logs. Auditor wants proof of least privilege & recent changes.

alex: Note: TKT-4256 shows proposed RBAC rollback on 2026-01-20. PR merged 2026-01-18 — include PR metadata and approver.

emma: For KMS logs: splunk index=security_kms. Example query I use: `index=security_kms key_alias="redwood-prod-unseal" (action=Decrypt OR action=Encrypt) | stats count by principal, action, date`

security-bot: export-job created: export-3141592653-1, ETA ~12m. (includes: k8s-rolebinding-diff, kms-events-20260101-20260215.csv, iam-policy-snapshots)

raj: I'll generate RBAC diffs via `kubectl get rolebinding -A -o yaml` and compare against git history: `git log -p -- Kubernetes/rbac/`. Plan to redact emails -> USER-<hash> before packaging.

maria: Auditor Q: Acceptable to provide aggregated principal list + individual change diffs? They also asked for per-actor events if privileged tokens used.

auditor_singh: Per-actor events required for any privilege elevation. Need tie between a service account token usage and KMS decrypts if customer data access occurred. Also need chain-of-custody for RBAC changes: PR, approver, timestamp.

emma: Approval metadata: PR #1123 merged by @jordan on 2026-01-18. Github audit record: `event: pull_request_review, action: submitted, review_state: approved, actor: jordan` — we can export that.

alex: On vuln triage: medium CVE from 2025-08 in dep X caused a temporary RBAC tighten on 2026-01-05. Include rationale notes.

raj: For incident mapping include timeline.csv (timestamp,event,actor,notes). I'll produce that.

maria: Auditor also requested proof of log retention policy for the period. Where is the S3 retention lifecycle stored?

emma: infra/logging/retention.yml + S3 lifecycle for bucket `redwood-logs-prod` is set to 365 days. Will attach a screenshot of the lifecycle rule and the infra file.

maria: Auditor wants KMS usage by environment/region. Can we provide per-region counts?

security-bot: export-job update: export-3141592653-1: kms-events CSV rows=3472, k8s-diffs=12 files, iam-snapshots=1 file. Link: https://internal-exports.redwood.com/exports/3141592653-1

auditor_singh: For ISO mapping reference A.9.1/A.9.4 and A.8.1. Provide mapping table control->evidence filename. CSV preferred.

maria: I'll prepare mapping.csv with columns: control,description,evidence_file and add it to the export.

alex: Quick check — any PII in the kube audit logs? If so redaction required prior to sharing.

raj: Kube audit contains user emails and node IPs. I'll run `scripts/redact-kube-audit.py --hash-salt=redwood2026` to replace emails with hashed tokens.

maria: Deadline: final package needed by EOD 2026-03-22. Who owns packaging and upload?

emma: I'll own packaging and push to secure s3 share with access limited to auditor principal.

raj: I'll finish RBAC diffs + timeline by EOD today and hand off to emma.

security-bot: export-job completed: export-3141592653-1 status=done. Download: https://internal-exports.redwood.com/exports/3141592653-1/status=done

auditor_singh: Received the export link, will start review and ping for clarifications. Please ensure the CSV mapping file is present and redaction notes included.

maria: Thanks everyone — ping me in thread if you need sign-off artifacts or help with redaction scripts.
